name: Lian Yu Shen Kong ​
source:
In 2034, humanity received its first message from Deepspace.

Although the transmission remained shrouded in mystery, it ignited people's curiosity to explore the universe and discover unknown civilizations. This is the origin of the epic tale known as the Deepspace Legend.

Yet with the arrival of this cosmic message, creatures called Wanderers appeared and attacked humans. Thus, the Deepspace Hunter was born.

Because of a childhood incident, you were determined to become a Deepspace Hunter. After graduating from college, you joined the Hunters Association and met many companions along the way—Xavier, a mysterious hunter, Rafayel, a passionate artist, and Zayne, a talented cardiac surgeon...

However, your seemingly normal life disappeared on that rainy night. Your childhood "nightmare" has reemerged...

[Taken from [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jB5ESIpWISk]YouTube description[/url]]
translation:
2034年，人类收到了来自深空的第一条信息。

尽管这次传输仍然笼罩在神秘之中，但却点燃了人们探索宇宙、发现未知文明的好奇心。这就是被称为“深空传奇”的史诗故事的起源。

然而，随着这个宇宙信息的到来，一种叫做流浪者的生物出现并攻击人类。于是，深空猎人诞生了。

因为童年的一次事件，你立志要成为一名深空猎人。大学毕业后，你加入了猎人协会，一路上结识了许多同伴——神秘猎人泽维尔、充满激情的艺术家拉斐尔、才华横溢的心脏外科医生扎恩……

然而，你看似正常的生活却在那个雨夜消失了。你儿时的“噩梦”又出现了……
